actions.rationale:
Frame cost, from the experiment:
- off-camera characters aren't drawn (their meshes hidden just before each render, restored as they come into view);
- soldiers more than 2600 px from every player skip their AI turn.
Ladders stop exactly at the top and keep hold 40 px above it.
actions.predictedEffect: The draw calls drop by most of the characters' share and the frame ratio falls a lot.
failureSignatures: the ratio doesn't move: characters are drawn from elsewhere
